column1: # Standalone partition table for 8 MB ESP32-S3 devices (Cardputer family).
# nvs and otadata sit exactly where Launcher puts them. Switching a device
# between Launcher and the standalone image must never move or resize the NVS
# that is being diagnosed — see docs/RESEARCH.md
# The Arduino core is built with core dumps to flash and logs an error at
# boot when this partition is missing. Same place as in Launcher's table.
